Presenter.Author: btrivunovic
Presenter.Title: Benchmark graphs (Queen, Mycielski) - number of colors
Presenter.Description: Comparison of algorithms on DIMACS-style benchmark graphs: Queen(n,n) for n=5..10 and Mycielski Myciel(k) for k=3..7.

TextBox_1.htmltext: Queen graphs are dense and highly structured (chromatic number at least n for Queen(n,n)), and reveal substantial differences between algorithms. Mycielski graphs are triangle-free with chromatic number k. In the conducted experiments, all five algorithms colored the tested Mycielski graphs optimally.
